text.en:
A new section is hereby inserted between sections three hundred and ninety-six and three
hundred and ninety-seven of Act Numbered One hundred and ninety which shall read as follows:
"Section 396i. Copy of service of summons to be sent to plaintiff.- It shall be the duty of the sheriff, within the
ten days next following the service of the summons, to give notice thereof by registered mail to the plaintiff or
his counsel."

This Act shall take effect forty days after publication in the Official Gazette.
Approved, December 2, 1926.
